description.value: The Sandman Hotel & Suites Prince George is a mid-scale chain property offering room types from standard doubles to two-bedroom kitchen suites, making it practical for multi-night touring stays requiring a kitchenette. The hotel has earned Gold Certification from GreenStep Solutions, assessed against Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards, reflecting meaningful operational sustainability commitments. Guests have access to a pool, exercise gym, coin-operated laundry, and two on-site restaurants.
